build_categorical_mpo_loss: build a CategoricalMPO instance with epsilon and epsilon_policy KL constraints for a discrete policy
create_mpo_params: create initial CategoricalMPOParams with log_temperature and log_alpha using init_params method
run_mpo_loss_computation: run the CategoricalMPO call method to compute loss and stats for online and target distributions
compute_e_step_weights: compute normalized importance weights and temperature loss using compute_weights_and_temperature_loss function
